children: Overview
UK retirement savings specialist's H1 2026 IFRS adjusted operating profit grew 25% yr/yr
Operating cash generation for H1 2026 rose 6% yr/yr
Co announced up to £2bn partnership to expand UK PRT business
Outlook
Standard Life expects mid-single digit percentage growth in operating cash generation annually
Company remains on track to achieve c.£1.1 bln IFRS adjusted operating profit in 2026
Standard Life to outline post-2026 strategic priorities and new financial guidance on November 30
Result Drivers
PENSIONS AND SAVINGS GROWTH - Co said higher assets under administration, improved margins, and product innovation drove strong earnings in Pensions and Savings
RETIREMENT SOLUTIONS CONTRIBUTION - Co said disciplined participation in Pension Risk Transfer and annuities markets supported growth in Retirement Solutions
COST EFFICIENCIES - Co said cumulative run-rate cost savings and operational efficiencies improved profitability
